_note: The board: 15 x 15 squares of 210 mm on a wooden slab whose top, where tiles sit, is at y = 40; each square a 202 mm plate between 8 mm grooves 5 mm deep, inside a rim 74 mm wide standing 10 mm over the squares. Square (row r, column c), both 0 to 14, has its centre at x = (c - 7) * 210, z = (r - 7) * 210 (the centre square is the origin; row 0 is the far edge, -z). The standard premium layout, as (row,col): 2L: 0,3 0,11 2,6 2,8 3,0 3,7 3,14 6,2 6,6 6,8 6,12 7,3 7,11 8,2 8,6 8,8 8,12 11,0 11,7 11,14 12,6 12,8 14,3 14,11; 2W: 1,1 1,13 2,2 2,12 3,3 3,11 4,4 4,10 7,7 10,4 10,10 11,3 11,11 12,2 12,12 13,1 13,13; 3L: 1,5 1,9 5,1 5,5 5,9 5,13 9,1 9,5 9,9 9,13 13,5 13,9; 3W: 0,0 0,7 0,14 7,0 7,14 14,0 14,7 14,14. The centre (7,7) is a double word marked by a star. Each other premium is stamped with its label (3W, 2W, 3L, 2L), white on the triple squares and brown on the double ones, so colour is not the only cue. The premium colours keep clear of the four player colours. Written by tools/models/world.py.
